prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE original flat biomedical mechanism icon: mature TGF-beta1 ligand HOMODIMER, two smooth elongated cystine-knot finger-like subunits arranged as a symmetric horizontal butterfly pair joined in the middle. Broad simple organic lobes, approximately horizontal dumbbell, recognizable two-subunit form. SINGLE isolated object, centered, generous transparent padding. Style: polished minimal biomedical educational vector-like icon, like a clean publication pathway figure. Uniform thin dark slate outline #3D5963, solid warm gold #E4BE78 subunit and pale mint #B3D7CC alternate subunit, at most these colors. Front orthographic view. Preserve broad accessible left and right outside tips for later receptor contacts. No membrane. No text, letters, arrows, circles, highlights, gradients, shadows, texture, 3D or other objects. Transparent background, true alpha.

Use case: scientific-educational. ONE isolated TGF-beta type II receptor, upright single-pass membrane receptor icon. A small rounded cysteine-rich extracellular globular domain at top, narrow straight transmembrane stalk in middle, one larger BILOBAL cytoplasmic serine/threonine kinase domain at bottom. Clearly just one extracellular domain and one connected bilobal kinase, no membrane drawn, no GS band. Overall slender vertical silhouette. Top extracellular lobe has an accessible shallow concave upper contact; kinase has a broad accessible right facing outer edge. Shared minimal biomedical family style: smooth rounded organic contour, thin uniform #3D5963 outline, solid flat teal #69ADB5 extracellular domain and stalk, pale purple #B2A6CD two kinase lobes. 2D front view, no perspective, shading, gradients, highlights, shadows, texture, text, arrows or badges. Generous padding, centered, truly transparent background.

Use case: scientific-educational. ONE isolated TGF-beta type I receptor ALK5 upright single-pass membrane receptor icon. A SMALL rounded cysteine-rich extracellular globular domain at top, narrow straight transmembrane stalk in middle, a small gold GS regulatory band directly below the transmembrane stalk, then one larger connected BILOBAL cytoplasmic serine/threonine kinase domain at bottom. One top extracellular domain, one stalk, one bilobal kinase, no membrane drawn. Slender vertical silhouette. Exposed left-facing side of GS band for type-II receptor activation; broad right facing edge of bottom kinase for SMAD substrate contact. Shared minimal biomedical family style: smooth rounded organic contour, thin uniform dark slate #3D5963 outline, solid teal #69ADB5 extracellular domain and stalk, gold #E4BE78 GS band, pale purple #B2A6CD kinase lobes. 2D flat front view. No gradients, highlights, shadows, texture, 3D, text, arrows or badges. Generous padding, centered, truly transparent background.

Use case: scientific-educational. ONE isolated full-length SMAD3 protein cartoon for a flat molecular mechanism figure. Upright compact vertical protein with a small rounded MH1 domain on top, a SHORT visibly curved thin linker, and a larger broad rounded MH2 domain below. MH2 has exposed smooth LEFT and RIGHT lateral faces for assembling with other SMAD proteins. A tiny gold short C-terminal SSXS tail projects from bottom of MH2. Single continuous connected protein; no separate free pieces. MH1 teal #69ADB5, linker dark slate, MH2 pale purple #B2A6CD, tail gold #E4BE78. Clean uniform thin #3D5963 outline. Flat solid vector-like fills, broad simple curves, generous transparent padding. No text, letters, P circles, arrows, DNA, membrane, shading, glow, translucent halos, shadows, gradients, highlights, 3D or texture. Strictly hard transparent outside boundary; no colored pixels beyond the dark contour.

MH1 pale mint #B3D7CC, MH2 teal #69ADB5, linker dark slate #3D5963. Clean uniform thin #3D5963 outline. Flat SOLID vector-like fills, broad simple curves, generous transparent padding. No text, letters, P circles, arrows, DNA, membrane, shading, glow, halos, shadows, gradients, highlights, 3D or texture. Strictly transparent beyond contour.
